headline: Petrobras Decline Pulls Brazilian Equities Lower Ahead of Central Bank Rate Decision
summary: Brazil's main stock index fell 1.5% as Petrobras shares slid 3.9%. The central bank is scheduled to decide on interest rates.
why: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil giant and the heaviest weight on the country's benchmark stock index, meaning its movements heavily dictate broader market direction.

impacts.name: Brazil main stock index
impacts.why: Petrobras' drop directly dragged down the broader Brazilian stock index due to its heavy weighting.
